To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a flexible digital signal processor system that allows user friendly code development and online-tuning has been developed to control a small wind turbine.

a flexible control strategy is presented for a 11-kW back-to-back power-converted small wind turbine that can operate in stand-alone and in grid-connection mode, and the grid failure and recovery can be detected automatically and the control mode can be switched accordingly.
a flexible control system with grid failure detection and automatic mode switch for a 11-kW small wind turbine has been developed and tested.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a flexible control system for small wind turbines capable of working in stand-alone and/or grid-connected mode.
the design, development and test of an 11-kV back-to-back converter for a wind turbine.
developing a flexible control strategy capable of operating the wind turbine in stand-alone mode and grid-connection modes, including grid-connected and isolated local grid operation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this research work has been able to demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed control system for a stand-alone and grid connection operation of a wind turbine with back-to-back power converters.
the presented control strategy is a flexible and reliable solution for small wind turbines with back-to-back power converters.
the developed control strategy is able to provide a flexible operation mode switch between the stand-alone and grid connected operation modes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a flexible and robust control scheme for stand-alone and grid connection mode of a small wind turbine is developed and tested.

we have developed a flexible and robust control strategy for small-scale wind turbine with a built-in back-to-back power electronic converter capable of operating in stand-alone mode and grid-connected mode, with the ability to detect and recover from grid failure.
we have developed and implemented a flexible control system that allows a small wind turbine to operate in stand-alone mode and to be connected to the grid.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is feasible to use a back-to-back converter with a standard flux vector control for a stand-alone wind power generation system.
the proposed control strategy can be used to operate the small wind turbine with a grid failure and recovery detection and switching between stand-alone and grid connection mode.
the proposed flexible control strategy can be applied for small-scale wind turbines with back-to-back power converters to work in stand-alone and connected mode.
